name: Miyoo Flip

models.name: Flip
models.notes: Single model; RK3566, requires GammaLoader patch for SD boot

summary: Miyoo's RK3566-based handheld. KNULLI states it cannot boot an OS from the SD slot by default: the stock firmware must be patched with GammaLoader first. After patching, the primary SD card slot is on the right side. MinUI also lists the Flip, with 'Legacy' support, and installs from the stock OS app loader.

variants.notes: RK3566 SoC. KNULLI: install GammaLoader (Gamma Bootloader Installer app on the stock OS) before KNULLI so the device can boot from SD; the stock OS stays intact and still works. After patching, the primary SD card slot is on the right side. KNULLI interface: Emulation Station. MinUI lists the Flip as 'Legacy' and installs from the stock OS app loader.

firmware.version: Miyoo stock OS (installed on the device)

homebrew.name: KNULLI
homebrew.firmware: Per-model image (knulli-rk3568-miyoo-flip); boots from SD card after GammaLoader patch.
homebrew.summary: Batocera-based retro gaming OS for the Miyoo Flip. Requires GammaLoader patch of stock firmware to enable SD-card boot.

compatibility.note: KNULLI's Miyoo Flip page requires a GammaLoader patch before KNULLI can boot from SD. KNULLI Scarab 20260511 provides knulli-rk3568-miyoo-flip. Stock OS remains intact after patching.

requirements: A good-quality SD card formatted to FAT32.
GammaLoaderMiyooFlip.zip from Gamma's GitHub repository (linked from the KNULLI Miyoo Flip page).
A computer with an SD card reader and an image writer.
warnings: Follow the KNULLI GammaLoader steps precisely. KNULLI says a failed install can leave the device not booting, and recovery then requires opening the case and pressing a button on the mainboard (KNULLI links an unbrick guide; spruceOS has a Miyoo Flip eMMC unbricking guide).
After GammaLoader installation, the primary (KNULLI) SD card slot is on the right side; the GammaLoader SD card goes in the left slot.
Do not interrupt the GammaLoader installation; the device may reboot a few times.

homebrew.name: MinUI
homebrew.firmware: Custom launcher and libretro frontend on an SD card; installed from the stock OS app loader.
homebrew.summary: Focused custom launcher and libretro frontend; its supported-devices table lists the Miyoo Flip as 'Legacy'.

compatibility.note: MinUI's supported-devices table lists 'Miyoo Flip' (added MinUI-20250111-0) with status 'Legacy' (checked 2026-10-29).

requirements: A new branded microSD card formatted to FAT32.
MinUI.zip and the miyoo355 folder from a MinUI release.
warnings: MinUI marks the Flip's support as 'Legacy', meaning it will be retired in a future update.
MinUI's install instructions put the card in the right slot (beneath the power button) and do not mention GammaLoader; only the KNULLI route documents the GammaLoader patch.

homebrew.name: spruceOS
homebrew.firmware: Frontend on top of the stock OS.
homebrew.summary: Custom Python-based frontend that runs on top of the stock OS on supported Miyoo devices.

compatibility.note: spruceOS lists the Miyoo Flip with 'Stable' support status.

requirements: A new branded microSD card (do NOT use the stock card).
warnings: spruceOS is a frontend, not a full OS replacement; it runs on top of the stock OS.
